data.name: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship
data.detailed_description:
Descubra a fascinante história de Mika, uma menina que consegue conversar com os cavalos, em sua tentativa de conquistar o corcel negro Ostwind.

Com base na franquia de filmes e livros best-sellers Livres Como o Vento (Ostwind), realize tarefas emocionantes cavalgando junto com Ostwind e explore livremente o ambiente maravilhoso do Estábulo Kaltenbach. Cavalgue com outros cavalos, procure objetos escondidos ou tente conquistar o primeiro lugar nas corridas. Inúmeros segredos e locais escondidos estão aguardando para serem descobertos!

Depois de um longo dia de aventuras nas lindas colinas de Kaltenbach, cuide do seu amigo com todo o amor! Para manter o seu novo amigo em ótimas condições, é preciso escová-lo, limpar seus cascos e muito mais. Ostwind fica feliz com um estábulo limpinho e quando você brinca com ele no padoque. Em troca, ele estará sempre ao seu lado durante suas aventuras, e vocês crescerão juntos a cada uma!

Forme uma equipe imbatível e um laço inesquecível com Ostwind.

  • Galope Ostwind e explore a linda área Alpina livremente
  • Aprenda a interagir naturalmente com o Ostwind e aproveite a liberdade para cavalgar
  • Escove o Ostwind cuidadosamente e fique de olho na saúde, no treinamento e na felicidade dele

reviews.review:
[h1]Cows are the fastest animals in the world[/h1]

Windstorm/Ostwind is an open world horse riding game. Basically everything about it is mediocre but since it's really niche and small budget game is not too bad.

The game is about you taking care of your horse and riding it in a huge open world map. There are missions like riding somewhere to take a photo of other animals, time trial races, obstacle courses, catching cows (I didn't know cows are faster and more agile than horses but whatever) or finding hidden horses. Beside all of that there are collectible items you can find. And all activities grant you XP which you spend on improving skills of the horse.
When you take your horse back home you can clean the pasture, brush your horse and clean him to keep him happy so you could ride again.
That's pretty much it. The game is short but if you love riding around you might get 10 or 15 hours of gameplay maybe.

The game is easy so it will be fine for casual players or small children. None of the activities are challenging. Well maybe except catching those damn cows. But anyway this was clearly made for kids and casual gamers.

The controls are average. Sometimes it's hard to control the horse and animations are really bad, like there are barely any animations, it feels stiff.
The world on the other hand looks decent with lots of different locations to discover and some of those are really beautiful.
Graphics are decent for low budget title. It may look like a mobile game but you can see there has been some work put into making this game. So technically it looks like crap, but artistically it's good at times.
Performance is weird. I guess no matter what PC you have it will be stuttery sometimes and you'll see objects popping in all the time.
There's native ultrawide support (most likely unintentional but hey it's there).

Sound like everything else is average. There's some voiced lines, voiceovers remind me all those HoG games.

I don't know what else to say. It's a decent game to get on sale. I probably wouldn't recommend it but since there's not much choice in the genre i'll give this a thumbs up.
Btw don't forget to read the forums on how to make achievements work, developers have a simple solution for that.

[b]Pros[/b]
[list[
[*]Nice map
[*]Pretty unique
[*]Really relaxing
[*]Cute
[/list]
[b]Cons[/b]
[list]
[*]Poor graphics
[*]Terrible animations
[*]Lacks activities
[*]Performance is weird
[/list]
